suite.doc:
Cross-browser login check against the Applitools ACME Bank demo (https://demo.applitools.com) — Chromium and Firefox.
Replaces this repo's original login.robot/Web-Keys.robot, which had rotted (broken selectors/library versions after not being touched for a long time). Current selectors (#username, #password, #log-in) verified live against the real site on 2026-09-24, not assumed from the old code.
Dropped the original's "Bad Logins" scenario: verified live that the demo site has no real credential validation at all — a blank submit still reaches the dashboard — so there's no error state left to actually assert against. Keeping that test would mean reproducing the exact "looks like it verifies something, doesn't" problem this rewrite exists to fix.
WebKit is intentionally left out of the browser list below: it hangs on page navigation on this particular dev machine even after fixing the missing libwebkitgtk-6.0-4 system library — looks like a WebKit-on-Linux environment quirk specific to this box, not a defect in the suite itself (Chromium and Firefox both verified working end to end). Add "webkit" back to the FOR loop below once that's sorted out, or if running this on a different machine where it isn't an issue.
